agentic_mapping.agentic_equivalent: every variation priced + client-signed BEFORE work starts — no verbal extras, ever

agentic_mapping.agentic_equivalent: valuations on cycle; retentions (2.5-5%, 12mo) tracked per project with release dates

agentic_mapping.agentic_equivalent: subbies verified with HMRC (20/30%), deductions on statements, insurance + RAMS gated before site
agentic_mapping.notes: Same cert-gating invariant: no valid docs, no site access

agentic_mapping.agentic_equivalent: snag items with photos + owners + dates; handover pack (certs, manuals, warranties) compiled
agentic_mapping.notes: Handover pack quality decides final payment speed

agentic_mapping.agentic_equivalent: principal-contractor duties tracked; RAMS per phase; toolbox talks logged
